copy: **I work at the intersection of marine ecology and machine intelligence**, applying AI and emerging imaging technologies — computer vision and deep learning — to evaluate **biodiversity stability in complex marine environments.** My work runs the whole pipeline: collecting and annotating underwater imagery, training detection and classification models, then folding their output back into ecological assessment. **Automated vision is how ocean monitoring keeps pace with the climate crisis.**
